reasoning: The complete bipartite graph K_{6,6} on 12 vertices (partitioning vertices 0-5 and 6-11) is triangle-free because bipartite graphs have no odd cycles. It is maximal because adding any edge within a partition would create a triangle with any vertex from the opposite partition. With 36 edges, it achieves Mantel's theorem bound (floor(12²/4)=36), making it both maximum and maximal.
